row: 蘭嶼位於臺東外海，面積約45平方公里，是達悟族的家園，族語稱 Pongso no Tao（人之島）。島上有拼板舟、飛魚季，以及35種只見於蘭嶼的植物；最高峰紅頭山海拔552公尺。

title.en: The Island of People in Modern Times

tagline.zh-Hant: 從封閉的研究區，到核廢料與補償
tagline.en: From a closed research area to nuclear waste and compensation

zh: 達悟族稱這座島為 Pongso no Tao，
意思是「人之島」。
en: The Tao call this island Pongso no Tao,
the island of human beings.

zh: 十七世紀的日本地圖寫作「Tabako」；
菲律賓人至今仍稱它 Botel Tobago。
en: Seventeenth-century Japanese maps wrote Tabako;
Filipinos still call it Botel Tobago.

zh: 日治時期，這裡稱為「紅頭嶼」，
被劃為民族學研究區，不對一般人開放。
en: Under Japanese rule it was called Kōtō
and made an ethnological research area closed to the public.

zh: 海拔約324公尺的蘭嶼氣象站是日治時期的建築，
由當時的總督府徵調達悟族人修建。
en: The weather station, about 324 metres up, dates from Japanese rule;
the colonial government made Tao men build it.

zh: 二次大戰時，它曾遭盟軍轟炸；
主建築的牆上至今還留著彈痕。
en: In the Second World War it was bombed by the Allies;
bullet marks still scar the main building.

zh: 東清外海的軍艦岩，相傳戰時被美軍飛機
誤認為軍艦而轟炸，部落至今流傳這段軼聞。
en: Off Dongqing, Battleship Rock is said to have been bombed by American aircraft
that took it for a warship; the village still tells the tale.

zh: 1946年1月19日，蘭嶼成為臺東縣的一個鄉；
1947年，政府定名為「蘭嶼」。
en: On 19 January 1946 the island became a township of Taitung County;
in 1947 the government named it Lanyu, Orchid Island.

zh: 戰後，禁止外人入島的限制延續下來，直到1967年才解除。
en: After the war the ban on outsiders stayed in place until 1967.

zh: 同一年起，島上開始興建學校，
國語成為必修。
en: From that year schools were built on the island
and Mandarin became compulsory.

zh: 1982年，島的南端建成核廢料貯存場，
事前沒有徵詢居民。
en: In 1982 a nuclear-waste store was built at the southern tip
without consulting the residents.

zh: 場內存放約十萬桶來自三座核電廠的廢料；
2002年，近兩千人靜坐抗議。
en: It holds about 100,000 barrels of waste from three nuclear plants;
in 2002 almost 2,000 people staged a sit-in.

zh: 政府核定發給居民25.5億元補償。
en: On 22 November 2019 the government awarded
residents NT$2.55 billion in compensation.

zh: 今天，飛機約半小時往返臺東，
渡輪全年從臺東富岡漁港出發。
en: Today flights reach Taitung in about half an hour,
and ferries sail from Taitung's Fugang harbour all year.

zh: 封閉、開放、抗爭，
人之島的近代史還在寫。
en: Closed, opened, protested over:
the island of people is still writing its modern history.

title.en: Plank Boats and the Seasons of Flying Fish

tagline.en: The sea-going life of the Tao

zh: 八代灣的灘上停著達悟族的拼板舟，
是蘭嶼最具代表性的景觀之一。
en: Tao plank boats rest on the beach at Badai Bay,
one of the island's best-known sights.

zh: 船身用斧頭削成的木板拼成，
再以木釘與藤條接合。
en: The hulls are built of planks shaped with an axe
and joined with wooden dowels and rattan.

zh: 因為不是整根樹幹挖成的，
它不算獨木舟。
en: Because they are not hollowed from one trunk,
they are not dugout canoes.

zh: 船身漆上紅、白、黑三色紋樣，
船頭與船尾插著雞羽。
en: Hulls are painted in red, white and black,
with chicken feathers at bow and stern.

zh: 常見的圖案有人形、波浪，
以及同心圓外圍三角形的「船眼」。
en: Common motifs are a human figure, waves
and the eye of the boat, concentric circles edged with triangles.

zh: 船有一到三人座，
也有六人、八人與十人座。
en: Boats seat one to three people,
or six, eight or ten.

zh: 新船下水時殺豬祭祀，眾人把船拋向空中數次；
船穩穩浮在水上，儀式才算完成。
en: At a launch pigs are sacrificed and the boat is tossed into the air several times;
once it floats, the ceremony is complete.

zh: 族人以耕作與捕魚為生，
每年仰賴大量的飛魚漁獲，也種水芋、山藥與小米。
en: Islanders farm and fish, relying on a large catch of flying fish each year,
and grow wet taro, yams and millet.

zh: 一年分成三季：約二到五月是飛魚季 Rayon，
六到十月 Teyteyka，十一月到一月 Amyan。
en: The year has three seasons: Rayon, the flying-fish season, about February to May;
Teyteyka, June to October; Amyan, November to January.

zh: 蘭嶼有七個社區，其中四個是行政村：
椰油、朗島、東清與鄉公所所在的紅頭。
en: The island has seven communities; four are administrative villages:
Yeyou, Langdao, Dongqing and Hongtou, the township seat.

zh: 2023年2月，全鄉人口約5,255人，
其中多數是達悟族人。
en: In February 2023 the township had about 5,255 residents,
most of them Tao.

zh: 1967年政府興建的水泥房屋，
曾被族人視為對傳統文化的冒犯。
en: Concrete houses built by the government in 1967
were seen by the community as an affront to its culture.

zh: 達悟語屬於巴丹語群，
與菲律賓巴丹群島的伊巴丹語相近。
en: The Tao language belongs to the Batanic group,
close to Ivatan in the Philippine Batanes.

zh: 蘭嶼被視為潛力世界遺產；
海與船，仍是島上生活的中心。
en: Orchid Island is considered a potential World Heritage Site;
the sea and its boats are still at the heart of island life.

title.zh-Hant: 三十五種只在這裡的植物

tagline.en: Wet hills, sea turtles and whales

zh: 蘭嶼的年均溫，山上約23度，
海岸約26度。
en: On Orchid Island the mean temperature is about 23 °C in the hills
and 26 °C on the coast.

zh: 氣象站記錄的年平均雨量，
en: The weather station records an average
of about 2,979 mm of rain a year.

zh: 島上有35種植物，
只見於蘭嶼。
en: Thirty-five plant species
grow nowhere but here.

zh: 其中一種特有的棕櫚，
學名 Pinanga tashiroi。
en: One of them is a palm found only here,
Pinanga tashiroi.

zh: 綠蠵龜會上蘭嶼的海灘產卵。
en: Green sea turtles come ashore on the island to nest.

zh: 周圍的海裡，
記錄到四種海蛇。
en: In the surrounding sea
four species of sea snake have been recorded.

zh: 軍艦岩一帶洋流湍急、暗礁多，
魚類多而且種類多樣。
en: Around Battleship Rock the currents race over hidden reefs,
and fish are many and varied.

zh: 情人洞下，岩石把海水圍成深潭，
水色清澈見底。
en: Below Lovers' Cave the rocks hold a deep pool of sea water,
so clear the bottom shows.

zh: 大翅鯨過去常見於這片海域；
2000年代又有目擊，是捕鯨結束後首次回到臺灣海域。
en: Humpback whales were once common here;
sightings in the 2000s marked their first return to Taiwanese waters since whaling.

zh: 北岸的雙獅岩，
是海蝕留下的堅硬岩塊。
en: On the north coast, Twin Lions Rock
is hard rock left standing by the sea.

zh: 島的東南外海，
無人居住的小蘭嶼隔海相望。
en: Off the south-east
lies uninhabited Lesser Orchid Island.

zh: 小蘭嶼上生長著一種蝴蝶蘭，
它被列為極度瀕危。
en: Lesser Orchid Island is home to a critically endangered orchid,
Phalaenopsis equestris f. aurea.

zh: 山上的森林、海岸與珊瑚礁，
一起構成這座島的生態。
en: Hill forest, shore and reef
together make up the island's life.

zh: 人之島，也是許多物種唯一的家。
en: The island of people is also the only home of many species.

title.en: A Volcanic Island on the Bashi Channel

tagline.zh-Hant: 安山岩、海蝕岩與全臺最高的燈塔
tagline.en: Andesite, sea-carved rock and Taiwan's highest lighthouse

zh: 蘭嶼面積約45平方公里，隔著巴士海峽
與菲律賓的巴丹群島相望。
en: Orchid Island covers about 45 square kilometres; across the Bashi Channel
lie the Batanes of the Philippines.

zh: 它是一座火山島，
由安山岩與火山碎屑構成。
en: It is a volcanic island
of andesite and volcanic fragments.

zh: 火山最後一次噴發，在中新世。
en: The volcano last erupted in the Miocene.

zh: 最高峰紅頭山海拔552公尺；
島上有八座山超過400公尺。
en: The highest peak, Mount Hongtou, rises to 552 metres;
eight mountains top 400 metres.

zh: 海底火山噴發造出了蘭嶼，地層以安山岩質熔岩
與玄武岩質集塊岩為主。
en: Undersea eruptions built the island; its rocks are mostly andesitic lava
and basaltic agglomerate.

zh: 長年的海蝕與風化，留下堅硬不易風化的岩塊，
形成各種奇岩。
en: Ages of waves and weather left the hardest blocks behind
as strange rock shapes.

zh: 東岸外的軍艦岩，
外形就像一艘軍艦。
en: Off the east coast, Battleship Rock
looks just like a warship.

zh: 情人洞四周岩石崢嶸，
巨浪拍打其間，濤聲隆隆。
en: Around Lovers' Cave jagged rocks
take the pounding of the waves.

zh: 蘭嶼有新舊兩座燈塔；新燈塔在西北側的丘陵頂，
是全臺海拔最高的燈塔。
en: The island has two lighthouses; the new one stands on a hilltop in the north-west,
the highest lighthouse in Taiwan.

zh: 舊燈塔在開元港邊的小丘上，
棄用已久，步道整修後可以走上去。
en: The old one sits on a knoll by Kaiyuan Harbour,
long out of use, reached now by a restored path.

zh: 西岸的開元漁港，
就在舊燈塔腳下。
en: Kaiyuan Harbour on the west coast
lies just below the old lighthouse.

zh: 沿著海岸往北，
朗島漁港在島的北岸。
en: Following the coast north,
Langdao Harbour sits on the north shore.

zh: 南部高地上的氣象站海拔約324公尺，
從這裡能看見島的南岸與外海。
en: The weather station on the southern heights sits about 324 metres up,
looking over the south coast and the open sea.

zh: 火山、海浪與時間，
雕出了人之島的模樣。
en: Volcano, waves and time
have carved the island of people.
